name: HORS
fix_description: Function 0xf78283c7 (func_0094) transfers contract-held tokens and adds liquidity via a caller-supplied router address, with no access control. Any caller can pass a malicious router address to receive token approvals, draining the contract. Fix: add onlyOwner modifier, and validate that the router parameter matches a trusted router address stored in contract state.
difficulty_reasoning: This is a short, straightforward fake-router/input-validation exploit: the attacker flash-borrows a small amount, tricks the vulnerable contract into calling attacker-controlled addLiquidity, pulls LP tokens, and removes liquidity. It involves only a few steps and standard AMM interactions, with an obvious missing validation issue and a compact PoC.
